description: Source code for Bedrock API integration, implementing methods for credential management, message conversion, streaming responses, reranking, and client setup within a larger AI/LLM project.

classes.name: BedrockApi
classes.description: Class implementing the BaseLlmApi interface for interacting with AWS Bedrock, handling credentials, message conversion, streaming, reranking, and client management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes BedrockApi with configuration, validating AWS credentials.

methods.name: getCreds
methods.description: Retrieves AWS credentials, either from config or via provider chain.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a BedrockRuntimeClient with appropriate credentials and region.

methods.name: _oaiPartToBedrockPart
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat content parts to Bedrock ContentBlock format.

methods.name: _convertMessages
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat messages to Bedrock message format, handling roles and content parts.

methods.name: _convertBody
methods.description: Converts chat completion parameters into Bedrock ConverseStreamCommandInput, including system message and tools.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs non-streaming chat completion by accumulating streamed chunks.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks from Bedrock API, handling content and tool use.

methods.name: completionNonStream
methods.description: Throws error; not supported by Bedrock.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Throws error; not supported by Bedrock.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Throws error; FIM not supported by Bedrock.

methods.name: getInvokeModelResponseBody
methods.description: Invokes a model via AWS SDK and returns the parsed JSON response.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Performs reranking of documents using Bedrock's invoke model API, handling AWS errors.
